historicalComparison.reason: The SHA-pinned full 4.4.1 source was unavailable. This review does not assert historical parameter-schema equality.

runtimeValidation: Not performed by this review; source and current OpenAPI evidence do not establish Apple or MCP acceptance.
reviewDecisions: Every reviewed operation method/path resolves in the pinned contract. Every query entry is optional and its complete parameter definition is fingerprinted. Every body entry resolves to an optional property; referenced input schemas and required ancestor chains are captured.

Nested limits are optional integers with an Apple maximum and descriptions restricting them to included relationships. Existing exclusions retain base-only, dedicated-child, or explicitly bounded-preview contracts. New placement limits remain omitted from legacy projections.

Includes remain optional arrays of allowed relationship strings. Fixed includes used by build, IAP, subscription and promoted-purchase handlers were checked against current enum values. Expanded Asset Library choices do not change the legacy output contract.

Filter omissions preserve exact-name/email/build selection, complete review/statistics/recovery inventories, parent-scoped legacy media, and existing territory-focused commerce behavior. Sort omissions preserve set-based recovery or legacy natural order; no newly configurable filter or sort is implied.
Both legacy performance platform filters currently enumerate only IOS. Their existing unfiltered request behavior is preserved without promising results on other platforms.

CPP standalone version creation still has no top-level included graph; full page creation constructs its inline version/localization graph internally. PPO retains separate V1 and V2 parent fields and current handlers use V2 only.

Build expiration, export-compliance answers, declaration attachment, review submit/cancel transitions, version build linkage and subscription inline offer/price graphs remain separate mutation contracts. Optional nullable values are not sent implicitly.
Localization create placement relationships and version-only review asset relationships are omitted explicitly to preserve the separate preview/apply path for new assets.
GRAC classification-number write support is explicitly deferred: it is separate from Korea enum support and needs documented validation plus authorized draft acceptance before exposure.
